items.headline: Samuel Harris scores 2 TDs, Wyoming beats UTEP 27-15 for 6th consecutive win
items.description: — Landon Sims threw for 289 yards and a touchdown in his first career start, Samuel Harris added two touchdowns and Wyoming beat UTEP 27-15 on Saturday night for its fifth consecutive win.

items.headline: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
items.description: Travel plans for teams in multiple sports were disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

items.description: Wyoming (6-3) at UTEP (1-8), Nov. 14 at 10 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Alejado-Lacaden combo helps send Hawaii past UTEP 17-14
items.description: — Micah Alejado threw for 303 yards and a touchdown and Titan Lacaden had a career-high 109 yards receiving and a touchdown and Hawaii beat UTEP 17-14 on Saturday.
